name: Wings of Beyond
summary:
Wings of Beyond is an intense shoot 'em up that throws you into thrilling space battles filled with challenges and powerful upgrades. Take on 30 increasingly difficult stages, where quick reflexes and smart strategy are essential to survive relentless waves of enemies. Travel across three unique galactic systems, each featuring distinct environments, exclusive enemies, powerful bosses, and new challenges that demand different tactics.

Unlock upgrades to strengthen your ship and customize your playstyle. You can also personalize your journey with over 30 unique ship skins. With fast-paced arcade action, rewarding progression, and intense combat, Wings of Beyond challenges you to venture ever deeper into the unknown.
